caption:
Things that can look like ADHD, and why a careful assessment checks for them.

Focus, memory and restlessness shift with sleep, health, stress and mood. Poor sleep can bring forgetfulness and trouble concentrating. Hearing or vision problems, thyroid conditions, anaemia and some medicines or stimulants can affect attention. Trauma, anxiety and low mood overlap with ADHD, and can also occur alongside it. Research on hormones and perimenopause is still early and mixed.

Australian guidelines ask clinicians to check for these before, and alongside, an ADHD diagnosis. That is why our assessment includes a health and sleep history, and a letter for your GP about anything worth checking.
